meta.dry_run_note: FAKE BACKEND: every quality number is junk; usd figures are a pessimistic projection

design.lever_tag_note: all lever runs share replicate tag L1, so a request that is byte-identical across two lever configs (e.g. the large-tier intent call in the three context configs) is made once and reused; its recorded usage is still charged to each config's cost per question

gate.formula: MDE = max((t_{1-alpha,k-1} + t_{power,k-1}) * sigma_run * sqrt(1/k + 1/r), 1/n); alpha=0.05 one-sided, power=0.80, sigma_run = SD(ddof=1) of the k baseline run means; lever holds on a metric iff (mean baseline - mean lever) <= MDE; passes iff it holds on every gated metric
gate.preregistered: README.md section 'Pre-registration' (2026-11-13), committed before any lever ran

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.description: every step on the larger tier, all 20 candidates whole (~2.9k est. tokens), no prompt caching
